title_vi: Lỗi khi gọi web: khi nào thử lại, và thử lại sao cho không làm tệ thêm

claims.claim_vi: The source says: do not retry 4xx, retry 5xx carefully; use exponential backoff with a capped number of retries in the browser; use a flow-control gateway with a rate limiter (token bucket or leaky bucket) and a circuit breaker on the server.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: A circuit breaker has Closed, Open and Half-Open states: failures above a threshold within a period open it and start a timer; when the timer expires it goes half-open and lets a limited number of requests through; success closes it, any failure reopens it. Half-open protects a recovering service from a flood.
claims.verified_by: Read from docs/patterns/circuit-breaker.md of MicrosoftDocs/architecture-center (main branch, fetched 2026-10-19).

claims.claim_vi: 4xx means the request is at fault and 5xx that the server failed a seemingly valid request; 408 and 429 are 4xx codes that invite a later retry, and 429/503 may carry Retry-After; GET, PUT and DELETE are idempotent methods, POST is not.
claims.verified_by: Kiến thức chung của người biên soạn, chưa đối chiếu lại với trang này trong phiên viết (không mở được trang từ môi trường).

claims.claim_vi: Token bucket adds tokens at a fixed rate up to a capacity and each request takes one; leaky bucket releases queued requests at a steady rate.
claims.verified_by: Kiến thức chung của người biên soạn, chưa đối chiếu lại với trang này trong phiên viết (không mở được trang từ môi trường).

claims.claim_vi: Simulation (1000 clients, capacity 100 per tick, at most 8 retries, seeded): fixed 1-tick wait gives 900 succeeded, 100 gave up, 5400 requests, finished at tick 8; exponential wait 2,4,...,64 without jitter gives 900, 100, 5400, tick 254; exponential plus uniform random 0..bound gives 1000, 0, 2747, tick 21.
claims.verified_by: Run by the author on 2026-10-19 with a small Python program; a toy model, not a measurement of a real server.

design_notes_vi: Ba khung: bốn bước phía trình duyệt, ba thành phần phía máy chủ nối nhau, và kết quả mô phỏng dạng ghi chú.
source_deviations: The source states '4xx: do not retry'; the lesson adds that 408 and 429 invite a later retry and that retrying a non-idempotent request needs a de-duplication key.
The source does not mention jitter; the lesson adds random jitter and shows its effect in a toy simulation.
The lesson adds the Half-Open state of the circuit breaker, which the source does not describe in detail.
